nom: Clarins V-Facial Instant Depuffing Face Mask

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or eczema-prone skin describe the mask as instantly moisturizing and non-drying, with one noting it helped drying rash without irritation.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including one with rosacea and hormonal acne, report no irritation and describe soothing, silky results, and another with sensitive skin confirms it still firms without discomfort.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-60s report visible firming, less sagging around the jaw and lower cheeks, and softened fine lines, though one 50-year-old with fine lines and puffiness saw no change after two uses.
segments.combination: One reviewer notes the mask feels oily-free with no residual cream, describing balanced hydration without heaviness.

concerns.aging: Many mature reviewers report firmer jawlines, reduced sagging, and softened fine lines around the mouth; one 50-year-old and one 40-year-old, however, saw no improvement in jowls, wrinkles, or lift after repeated use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers commonly describe skin feeling revived, plump, and hydrated after use, with dryness or tightness not reported by most; one reviewer with eczema-related dryness found it instantly moisturizing.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers with rosacea or general redness/discoloration report the mask calmed their skin and evened complexion, with no reviewer describing worsened redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with compromised or eczema-affected skin report the mask helped soothe and moisturize without disrupting their skin, though results are based on very few mentions.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers note reduced pigmentation or discoloration on the cheeks and smaller-looking pores after repeated use, though this is not a common theme.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers with hormonal or cystic acne report their breakouts improved or cleared after a few uses, while two other reviewers state the mask caused new breakouts on the chin.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the mask leaves no oily residue and feels balanced rather than greasy; oiliness is otherwise rarely discussed.

extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this product based on the reviews. However, it made my chin breakout really bad and I also didn't notice a difference with the rest of my face. Will not be using and returning this product.

I have used this twice so far and honestly I don't see a difference at all. I am halfway into my year 50 so I am looking to address the, thankfully, beginning stages of fine lines, wrinkles and collagen lost. I feel like aside from my eye area puffiness, my smile lines seem droopy unless I'm smiling Lol so I'm looking for a lift in that area. I feel like this mask is very very thick so after leaving it on for the recommended time its kinds hard to remove. I like using the disposable towels for both drying my face after I wash and by wetting it to remove masks or cleanser from my face and with this mask I need to go over my face fully twice and then I have to spot check to get and additional leftover mask. My face feels ok afterwards. Not dry not moisturized but just ok. I always immediately follow up with my hyaluronic acid and vitamin C serums so I haven't ever let my face sit untouched to see if my skin becomes dry or not. I use my red light therapy mask daily but usually at night so I haven't had the chance to see if it has any benefits on the masks effectiveness. Maybe I'll try on the weekend

I received a sample of this and on the first use, my compromised, drip/flaking, and very mild rosacea skin with hormonal acne began to clear up after a few days of use. When I rinsed this mask, my face never felt so silky and comforted as if I wrapped my skin in a silk sheet. I do have minor puffiness only under my left eye for some reason (due to allergies) in the morning so I can't vouch for the puff reduction the company claims. I tried the masks at night since I give myself 40 mins to get ready to leave for work hence limited on self care lol. I'll be purchasing full size for my experience as it felt so good plus relieved my other skin issues Will see how it goes with the puffy claims.

I'll start this by saying I am not Asian and, perhaps because of that, not the target demographic for this mask. Nevertheless, I love it so far. I have adult acne caused by hormones after getting an IUD—this, in conjunction with the brightening serum, has done wonders for my uneven complexion and cystic acne in just two applications. My round face somehow feels oval, my skin is taught, and I'm not puffy from hormones (or from the hot sauce I ate last night). Overall, would (and will) buy again. 10/10.
I was pleasantly surprised at how well this worked to firm up my 60-year-old sagging skin around lower cheeks and neck. Will definitely buy again.

Coming from a 50 years old, and definitely really picky when it's comes to a new product to try; and being my first time user I needed to be assured, that I did not waste my hard earned money on this amazingly to say Intensif Lifting Masque. My face usually dry from eczema, and the drying rash would be embarassing, but masque instantly help moisturized these area and left me with a glowing beautiful face. And also, it helped getting rid of the rings around my eyes. I call product "The Wonder Cream" is a must try judge it for yourself (the longer you leave it on the better your skin texture will become). Thank you for you so much!!! An God ßlessed!!!
I use this probably 2/3 times a week, after a long week or night. It actually works..your skin feels firmer and smooth. I have sensitive skin and it still works and feels great.
